title: sprint-doctor output
description: Canonical machine-readable output contract for the sprint-doctor role: a zero-tool, schema-validated diagnostic verdict over a pre-assembled incident. See agents/sprint-doctor.md and fleet-sprint/docs/escalate-to-llm-design.md sections 2.3-2.4 for the prose contract this mirrors. The runner -- never the doctor -- executes every consequence of a verdict; NEVER touch bd or git from this role.

classification.description: The triage bucket this incident falls into (design doc section 3). ENGINE_FLAW requires engineFlawReport (enforced below).

evidence.description: Short factual bullets; the engine logs this verbatim to the sprint log.

matchedRegistryEntry.description: The id of the symptom/remedy registry entry (design doc section 4) that matched, or null when none did.

action.description: The single action to execute. Mutually exclusive with probes -- exactly one of the two must be present on every response.

probes.description: Optional; requests the single bounded probe round INSTEAD of an action (design doc section 2.1). The runner resolves each probe's target (member/bead/log) from the consult's own scope -- do not embed arguments in the string. cross_member_redispatch is deliberately NOT a probe; request it as the retry_different_member action instead, since it costs a full dispatch. Mutually exclusive with action.

engineFlawReport.description: Required when classification is ENGINE_FLAW (enforced below).

proposedRegistryEntry.description: Optional. Logged for human review (doctor-proposals.jsonl + harvest analysis) and NEVER auto-applied by the engine.

humanActionRequired.description: Required when action.kind is pause_for_human, or when action.kind is abort_sprint and classification is ENGINE_FLAW or UNCLEAR (enforced below). A vague or command-free referral is schema-legal but contract-rejected the same way an actionless CHANGES_NEEDED reviewer verdict is.

kind.description: The eight incident actions, plus the five re-plan actions (prefix replan_) that answer a doer BLOCKED report. A re-plan action MUST carry `replan` (enforced below); the runner applies it through existing verbs and re-dispatches the bead only when its content actually changed.

repairs.description: Registry remedy verbs to apply (design doc section 2.5 executor mapping); only meaningful when kind is repair_environment_then_retry.

member.description: Target member name; must be a member of the sprint's own member list.

timeoutMultiplier.description: Scales the redispatch timeout; capped at 2 (matches the integ-test 2x ceiling precedent).

salvageWip.description: Opt-in rescue-branch commit of uncommitted member WIP before defer/abort (design doc section 2.5 salvage pre-step).

replan.description: Required by every replan_* action kind (enforced below); meaningless on any other kind.

The re-plan payload for a bead a doer reported BLOCKED on. Every field is DATA the runner applies through an existing verb -- the doctor never edits a bead itself. Free text is runner-sanitized before it reaches any command string, so keep it plain and single-paragraph.

beadId.description: The bead this re-plan is for. Omit when the action's beadIds already names exactly one.

description.description: Replacement description the doer CAN complete from its seat. Applied as the bead's new body.

acceptance.description: Replacement acceptance criteria, checkable from the seat that will do the work.

issueType.description: New issue type, for a retype.

route.description: The role seat this bead should be worked from. Anything other than `doer` routes it to the verify set, where a test-runner role may close it on evidence.

split.description: For replan_rescope: exactly the parts the original bead decomposes into. The FIRST doer-role part becomes a child bead the doer can complete; the remainder stays on the original bead as the verify-set part a test-runner closes with evidence.

grant.description: A specific access escalation. `vcs_auth` and `llm_auth` are the two the orchestrator may perform itself through its existing provisioning path; the others await a human and the bead is excluded from the stagnation math until then.

proposedBeadTitle.description: A title for the engine's OWN tracker -- never auto-filed as a bead in the target project's DB (design doc section 7).

suggestedCommands.description: Displayed to the operator, never executed by the engine. Must not be empty -- an empty array is the actionless-referral shape this contract rejects.

registryEntry.description: Same 4-field-plus-id shape as a real doctor-registry.mjs entry (design doc section 4.1) -- id, classification, detect, remedy, verify, fallback.

allOf.description: Exactly one of action / probes per response.
Every replan_* action carries its replan payload.
replan_rewrite must say what the bead becomes: a replacement description, acceptance or title.
replan_route must name the role seat to route to.
replan_grant must name the specific access escalation.
replan_defer_with_credit must state why the bead is being parked.
action.kind abort_sprint with classification ENGINE_FLAW or UNCLEAR requires humanActionRequired.
